First, a few tips, if you stay at OYO Varcity Pearl:
* There is a facility to refill your water bottles with RO water. So, don't go on buying water bottles (unless you want mineral water). Just ask the reception area.
* Book the room on OYO at least in a day advance. Otherwise, it would be sold out on OYO, and you may have to pay a higher sum to get a room.

What I liked:
* Attached washroom.
* The price offered by OYO are quite competitive compared to the location at which the hotel is located.
* Hot water provided (tip: For hot water, turn tap's knob to left and open. For shower, pull the knob above tap and open the tap)

What I didn't like:
* AC makes too much noise.
* The exhaust fan in washroom doesn't work.
* Cupboard has broken doors.
* TV doesn't work. Only an HDMI pin is given, so maybe one can connect it to their laptop.
